g.text: r38 actual FPGA capture: 16 R beats consumed, then RVALID falls
PS AR = 0 | PS R = 16 | S01 R = 16 | RLAST on beat 16 | PS RID 0x20 / S01 RID 0
128 real samples, nominal 200 MHz (5 ns/sample); time relative to PL HP2 reset release.
RLAST is shown only with RVALID=1. No SDK, DMA or HDMI START. Samples outside this window are not drawn.
